title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: issuing a switch bill in exchange for a surrendered set
content:
## Scope

This Bills of Lading and Transport Documents policy governs the switch bill: a new set naming different parties that replaces a negotiable set, typically so that an intermediary can conceal its supplier. It applies when a documentation party asks for a switch bill in exchange for a document it holds.

## Formal clauses

1. A switch bill may be requested only for a document whose tier makes a switch bill available, and only while the number of switches already made on the booking is below that tier's maximum number of switches per shipment. The switches on a booking are counted, across every document of the booking, as the switch bill fees charged on those documents.
2. The requesting documentation party must hold a customer role, as registered on its customer record, that the AHL Switch Bill of Lading tier admits.
3. The first set is exchanged only after its full set of originals has been surrendered at the origin office.
4. The switch bill is drafted as a new AHL Switch Bill of Lading document for the same booking, with the new parties exactly as the documentation party supplies them and with the cargo particulars, ports and weights of the exchanged document unchanged.
5. The switch bill is approved and issued under the draft approval rules and the issuance rules. At its issuance the exchanged document is voided and charged the switch bill fee of the exchanged document's tier.
6. A switch fee is booked only on the exchanged document while it is surrendered.
7. Each switch request is charged at most once.
8. A switch bill itself can never be switched again.

## Eligibility checklist

| Check | Must show |
|---|---|
| Tier of the document to be exchanged | switch bill available |
| Switches already made on the booking | below that tier's maximum per shipment |
| Registered role of the requesting documentation party | a role admitted by the AHL Switch Bill of Lading tier |
| Originals of the first set | the full set surrendered at the origin office |
| Document to be exchanged | not itself an AHL Switch Bill of Lading |

## What changes and what does not

- **Taken from the documentation party, exactly as supplied:** the new parties.
- **Carried over unchanged from the exchanged document:** cargo particulars, ports and weights.
- **At issuance of the switch bill:** the exchanged document is voided and the switch fee is booked on it.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical cases)

- The booking already shows as many switch fees as the tier's maximum per shipment. A further switch bill is not available on that booking.
- Only part of the originals of the first set has been handed in at origin. The exchange does not proceed; the full set is required.
